name: rail-host-glyph-leading-box
description: rail: the host group row's drawn glyph (RailRow.module.css's .hostGlyph, RailRow.tsx's HostGlyph - two stacked units and their drive dots) occupies the SAME fixed-size leading box as the watch row's clock (.watchGlyph, WatchGlyph): a host is infrastructure drawn in the rail's one glyph grammar, so the two marks' boxes must measure equal width and height - a wider host glyph would read as a different visual language and shift its row's label off the x every other glyphed row holds

mutation.declaration: RailRow.module.css: .hostGlyph's width reverted from 13px to 17px (the host mark outgrows the glyph grammar's leading box)
mutation.note: The host glyph measures 17px against the watch glyph's 13px and fails on width; restoring width: 13px returns the case to PASS.
